archetypes.name: dyn-signal-lifecycle
archetypes.rationale: Signal-driven detach and reattach changes can regress lifecycle sentinels or cleanup boundaries.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the Step 3 signal-aware wrapper changes for lifecycle and cleanup regressions. Focus on whether TERM/HUP/INT paths preserve the live plan-review loop without leaking stale markers, whether reattach normalization preserves completion sentinels, and whether normal exits still perform identity-validated teardown and tmpdir cleanup. Check the Bash/Python boundary for races around result env persistence and marker cleanup. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
